name: ai-chat-platform
description: 前后端分离的 AI 应用基础工程

scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src frontend/vite.config.ts backend/src backend/test package.json README.md docs/api/openapi.yaml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend/src frontend/vite.config.ts backend/src backend/test package.json README.md docs/api/openapi.yaml
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
